correctness.rationale: At a=3(1-b)^2/4, x*=2/[3(1-b)], the linearization has eigenvalues -1 and b, 0<b<1. Exact center/stable coordinates give z'=-z-c(z+bw)^2, w'=bw-c(z+bw)^2, c=3(1-b)^2/[4(1+b)]; center graph coefficients through degree 4 produce a flip normal form s'=-s+p s^3+q s^5+O(s^6), p=c^2(1+b)/(1-b)>0 and q=c^4(1+b)(17b²-2b+5)/[4(1-b)^3]. Then S_n=s_{2n}^{-2} has increment 4p+(6p²+4q)/S_n+O(S_n^{-3/2}), implying 4pn+(3p/2+q/p)log n+C_s+o(1) by summable errors. In original x-coordinate, quadratic correction A=-c(1+b)/[2(1-b)] introduces signed sqrt and gives exactly the claimed K_b,H_b,L_b; exponential stable tracking perturbs residual by o(1). I independently recomputed rational normal-form conjugacies and all three amplitudes at b=1/4,1/2,3/4, including  K(1/2)=3/16 and L(1/2)=51/256. Stable-leaf exclusion and local-only quantifier are essential.
